discussion_comments.comment_body:
**[Critical]** Writer/parser round-trip breaks when the deployment base path ends with a `session` segment — Failure scenario: deploy under `/app/session/` → `buildSessionPathname('/app/session/', 'real-id')` produces `/app/session/session/real-id` (the regex `/^(.*)\/session\/[^/]+\/?$/` fails because `[^/]+` requires at least one non-slash character after `/session/`, so the fallback appends a new session segment). On refresh, `getSessionIdFromUrl` in `main.tsx:82` (`/\/session\/([^/]+)/`, unanchored, first match) parses the literal string `session` as the session id, so the app tries to resume a nonexistent session named `session` instead of `real-id`.

Fix: anchor the parser to the last occurrence to agree with the greedy writer:
```ts
// main.tsx
window.location.pathname.match(/\/session\/([^/]+)\/?$/)
```
Or have `buildSessionPathname` treat a trailing `/session` base segment as part of the session route.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Critical]** 当部署基础路径以 `session` 段结尾时，写入/解析的往返会断裂 — 失败场景：部署在 `/app/session/` 下 → `buildSessionPathname('/app/session/', 'real-id')` 产出 `/app/session/session/real-id`（正则 `/^(.*)\/session\/[^/]+\/?$/` 不匹配，因为 `[^/]+` 要求 `/session/` 后至少有一个非斜杠字符，所以回退逻辑追加了新的 session 段）。刷新后，`main.tsx:82` 中的 `getSessionIdFromUrl`（`/\/session\/([^/]+)/`，未锚定、取首个匹配）将字面量 `session` 解析为 session id，导致应用尝试恢复名为 `session` 的不存在会话，而非 `real-id`。

修复：将解析端锚定到最后一次出现，与贪婪写入端一致：
```ts
// main.tsx
window.location.pathname.match(/\/session\/([^/]+)\/?$/)
```
或让 `buildSessionPathname` 将以 `/session` 结尾的基础路径段视为会话路由的一部分。

</details>

**[Critical]** `dispatchedNotifications` is keyed on `String(notification.id)` — but GitHub's notification `id` identifies a **thread**, not an event. It stays the same across the thread's entire lifetime. Once a thread dispatches once, `recordDispatched` at line 231 records that stable ID, and every subsequent event on the same thread is silently `continue`'d before any lane runs.

**Failure scenario:** A thread where the bot dispatches once (e.g. an initial `@bot` mention) becomes permanently unresponsive. Subsequent mentions, review requests, or assignments on the same thread are silently skipped. Worst case: a thread where someone chatted first is muted before the bot is ever asked anything — the `mention` noise-reduction path records the notification even when it dispatched *nothing*. The cursor evicts only after 500 *other* threads dispatch.

**Fix:** Key on `${notification.id}|${notification.updated_at}` to distinguish events within the same thread, or remove `dispatchedNotifications` entirely since `dispatchedComments` (keyed on `node_id`, unique per comment) already covers the `markNotificationsAsRead`-failure dedup scenario.

```suggestion
const notifId = `${notification.id}|${notification.updated_at}`;
if (this.isDispatched(this.cursor.dispatchedNotifications, notifId)) {
  continue;
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

`dispatchedNotifications` 以 `String(notification.id)` 为键——但 GitHub 的通知 `id` 标识的是**线程**而非事件，在线程的整个生命周期内保持不变。线程一旦下发过一次，第 231 行的 `recordDispatched` 就会记录该稳定 ID，之后同一线程上的所有事件在任何 lane 执行之前就被 `continue` 跳过。

**故障场景：** 线程首次下发后（如一条 `@bot` 提及），该线程永久失聪。后续的提及、review 请求或 assign 都被静默跳过。最糟的情况：线程里先有人闲聊了一句，bot 在被真正请求之前就已经被静音。

**修复：** 以 `${notification.id}|${notification.updated_at}` 为键区分同一线程内的不同事件。
</details>

**[Suggestion]** Comment body truncation here uses `String.prototype.slice` (UTF-16 code units) while `processMetaLane` (line 450) uses `Array.from().slice()` (Unicode code points) — Concrete cost: a comment body with a supplementary-plane emoji at index 999–1000 in UTF-16 would be split between surrogate pair halves, producing a garbled replacement character. Use `Array.from(body).slice(0, MAX_COMMENT_CHARS).join('')` to match the code-point-aware approach at line 450.

```suggestion
      const body = Array.from((c.body || '').trim()).slice(0, MAX_COMMENT_CHARS).join('');
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

此处的评论正文截断使用 `String.prototype.slice`（UTF-16 code unit），而 `processMetaLane`（第 450 行）使用 `Array.from().slice()`（Unicode code point）。如果评论正文中 supplementary-plane emoji 位于 UTF-16 索引 999–1000 处，会被从代理对中间截断，产生乱码。建议统一使用 `Array.from().slice()` 方式。

</details>

**Declined (left open for maintainer).** The re-fetch duplicate described here is already covered by event-key dedup: `findMetaTrigger` returns `null` once the trigger event's `node_id` is in `dispatchedEvents`, so a re-fetched `review_requested`/`assign` notification never reaches `processMetaLane` a second time. We intentionally did not add a `dispatchedBodies` guard at the top of the meta lane: that body key is shared with first-contact, so guarding on it would permanently suppress a legitimate review/assign trigger on any thread whose body was previously fed (until cursor eviction) — a worse regression than the narrow duplicate. The residual same-poll cross-lane case is addressed in the sibling thread.
